After the download, Bridgit checks it, then Android asks you to confirm the install.
Ready to install
Bridgit %1$s is downloaded and checked. Android will ask you to confirm the install. Your agents, keys, switches and log stay as they are.
Install
Allow installs from Bridgit
To install its own updates, Bridgit needs Android\'s \"Install unknown apps\" permission. On the next page, turn on \"Allow from this source\", then come back and tap Install.
Open settings
